استأمنت (form X)
# اِسْتَأْمَنْتُ (istaʔmantu) /is.taʔ.man.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَأْمَنَ (istaʔmana)
# اِسْتَأْمَنْتَ (istaʔmanta) /is.taʔ.man.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأْمَنَ (istaʔmana)
# اِسْتَأْمَنْتِ (istaʔmanti) /is.taʔ.man.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأْمَنَ (istaʔmana)
# اِسْتَأْمَنَتْ (istaʔmanat) /is.t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
